name: Roland V-Synth GT
description: Roland V-Synth GT elastic-audio synthesizer: the setup and system blocks and both temporary tones of the current patch (Upper and Lower: common, T-FX, step modulator, AP-Synthesis, vocal designer, and sixteen zones of oscillator, envelopes, LFOs and two COSMs), and the temporary patch they sit in, from the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: V-Synth GT MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, April 1, 2007)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from V-SynthGT_MI.pdf (sha256 3ef0f67cfa75405952e132fb2e905f06b2f1327a50f6b804b0cc3aa9fe470a9d). Model ID 00 00 21, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Cover: V-Synth GT MIDI Implementation, Version 1.00, April 1, 2007 (p1); the map's source block has no date or version.
Printed names kept as printed: "Sustine" for Sustain (Tone Envelope, every envelope), "Analog Wavefrom" (Tone Oscillator 00 1E and 00 52).
Tone Step Modulator prints "Track Loop Switch" once per track without the track number (00 03, 00 1B, 00 33, 00 4B); they are numbered 1-4 in printed order (stepMod.trackLoopSwitch1 … 4).
Tone Common's "Tone Tempo", "Chorus Switch" and "Reverb Switch" are printed "(not used)"; they are laid out as printed.

p20 <Example 2> computes TONE T-FX of TONE:003 but its prose calls the block "PATCH MFX" and writes "117 (sum)" for a sum of 41; its message bytes (F0 41 10 00 00 21 11 20 02 02 00 00 00 01 04 57 F7) agree with the map.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the D Beam, Time Trip Pad, knobs and pedals transmit (p5-6) is not mapped yet
coverage.tones: both temporary tones, whole: Upper at 10 00 00 00 and Lower at 10 01 00 00, every zone
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: T-FX, AP-Synthesis, vocoder and COSM parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
